errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, not a stacked bar chart. Each category has three separate, side-by-side bars.

errors.text_span: hellblau für „10,45 Euro bis unter 12 Euro“ und sehr hellblau für „übrige Betriebe“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors to the legend categories. The middle category, '10,45 Euro bis unter 12 Euro', is represented by a medium blue bar, not a light blue ('hellblau') one. The last category, 'übrige Betriebe', is represented by a light blue bar.
In the category 'überwiegend positiv', the longest bar (dark blue for 'unter 10,45 Euro') reaches approximately 9%, not 8%.

errors.text_span: und die Anordnung entspricht der alphabetischen Reihenfolge der Kategorien
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the categories on the vertical axis are sorted alphabetically. They are not.
